records.purpose: Adds a HUD_2D, BILLBOARD_3D or QUAD_3D surface showing one of the caller's sco.widgets panels and writes its nonzero, never-reused id. desc and pose sizes must cover the 1.0 structs (larger tails ignored); every double finite; per-kind rules: HUD centre and size in viewport fractions with zero normal/up, billboard zero normal and unit up, quad unit normal and unit up perpendicular within 1e-3; 3D extents (0, 1000] m, max_distance [0, 1e7] m (0 = no limit), coordinates within 1e12 m; flags 0 or OCCLUDE_RAYCAST (3D only); panel_id "<plugin id>.<name>" at most 63 bytes. 32 surfaces per plugin, 256 in all. Failure leaves the registry and *out_id unchanged.
records.buffer_contract:
`sco_result (*register_surface)(sco_plugin* self, const sco_surface_desc* desc, uint32_t* out_id);`

Failure leaves the registry and *out_id unchanged.
records.ownership: Host copies the pose and panel_id on success; caller keeps desc, pose and the string. No allocation transfer.
records.thread_affinity: Any thread; registry lock held only for the copy. No callbacks.
records.callback_context: No callbacks; desc, pose and panel_id are read during the call only.
records.reentrancy: No plugin code runs inside the service; calls from several threads are serialized by the registry lock.
records.results: OK; BAD_ARG invalid/released self, NULL or short desc/pose, unknown kind, any field outside the rules, NULL out_id; TOO_MANY per-plugin or host limit, id space exhausted or allocation failure; UNAVAILABLE stopped service. last_error names the refused field.
records.absent_capability: query_service NOT_FOUND when the host does not publish sco.ui.surfaces (it needs sco.ui started); UNAVAILABLE for an incompatible version. No game capability or renderer requirement.
records.cleanup: No cancellation entrypoint; synchronous. Unregister, plugin unload or crash (through the sco.ui release hook) and service Stop withdraw the surface.
